1.name: sintel-crossing-snowbound-mountains
1.caption: Sintel kneels in a white, barren mountain pass, weather and space emphasizing the difficulty of the search.
1.alt: Sintel kneeling in a bleak, snowy mountain pass.

2.name: sintel-finds-injured-baby-scales
2.caption: The wounded baby dragon first enters the story as a small, vulnerable animal rather than a fearsome creature.
2.alt: A wounded baby dragon resting against a stone wall with an injured wing.

2.name: sintel-comforts-young-scales
2.caption: A close view of Sintel and Scales conveys affection through eye-line, facial expression and proximity.
2.alt: Sintel gently cradling the small dragon Scales beside a warm fire.

3.name: scales-spreads-wings-above-city
3.caption: Scales balances on a narrow ledge, revealing the wings that make flight—and separation—possible.
3.alt: The small dragon Scales spreading its wings on a city ledge.

3.name: sintel-witnesses-abduction
3.caption: Sintel’s alarm fixes the abduction as an emotional rupture before she can understand everything she has seen.
3.alt: Close-up of Sintel reacting with alarm in the city.

4.name: sintel-searches-across-desert
4.caption: The desert journey enlarges the world and compresses time, making the long search legible through environmental change.
4.alt: Sintel resting beside rocks in a sun-baked desert landscape.

5.name: sintel-meets-the-shaman
5.caption: Firelight isolates Sintel’s response as the older guide helps shape her interpretation of the quest.
5.alt: Sintel listening in a dark, firelit interior.

6.name: sintel-receives-carved-emblem
6.caption: The circular emblem functions as a specific piece of information that Sintel uses to interpret the world ahead.
6.alt: A detailed round metal emblem held in front of Sintel.

7.name: sintel-confronts-adult-dragon
7.caption: The full-grown dragon fills the cave beside Sintel; their unequal physical scale also reveals her restricted understanding.
7.alt: A gigantic adult dragon towering over Sintel inside a shadowy cavern.

8.name: adult-dragon-wing-mark
8.caption: A close view of the dragon’s marked wing foregrounds bodily continuity at the moment of recognition.
8.alt: Close-up of a pale line on the surface of the adult dragon’s wing.

8.name: sintel-faces-the-passage-of-time
8.caption: Sintel’s face becomes the focus as the film finally makes the effects of elapsed time impossible to ignore.
8.alt: Sintel staring forward in shock during the recognition sequence.

9.name: sintel-examines-cave-crystals
9.caption: Blue glints and deep black stone narrow the image’s visual field compared with the open, sunlit city.
9.alt: Sintel reaching toward glowing blue crystals inside the dark cave.

10.name: shaman-plucks-stringed-instrument
10.caption: The musician’s instrument gives the tavern sequence a tactile acoustic source before the story returns to Sintel’s memories.
10.alt: An elderly musician playing a stringed instrument in an amber-lit interior.

11.name: sintel-quiet-after-revelation
11.caption: A quiet facial close-up asks viewers to reevaluate a character whose certainty has been shaken by new knowledge.
11.alt: Sintel looking down after the cave confrontation, with twisted roots behind her.

15.name: sintel-walks-into-final-light
15.caption: The closing landscape opens beyond Sintel, leaving the ending’s emotional direction unresolved rather than fully explained.
15.alt: Sintel walking away along a bright path beside pale plants.
